decision: Adopt tiled library GEMM inside the existing CPU attention extension. No prepared weight layout or public diagnostic switch is retained.
policy: Length >=32; at least half of each query tile/key-span rectangle is allowed by the mask; V finite. Other cases retain scalar contractions. Query tiles <=64; key spans shared across heads; scratch bounded by tile*max_span.
paired_accuracy: Maximum absolute logits/action difference 0.00048828125 at L64; zero at other shapes. Per-output tolerance is the existing production criterion 2e-3 + abs(reference)*2e-5.
limitations: CPU evidence only. Short-sequence timings use identical contraction algorithms, so their differences are run variation. No concurrent benchmark reports are included. Micro inputs are synthetic and have holes and full/1-token/64-token masks; the model pairs use production weights and benchmark inputs.
reproduce_micro: Copy microbenchmark.rs into crates/cpu-kernels/examples/bench_attention_gemm.rs on the final implementation; RAYON_NUM_THREADS=8 cargo run --offline --release -p cpu-kernels --example bench_attention_gemm
reproduce_paired: Apply diagnostic.patch on the base revision; RAYON_NUM_THREADS=8 cargo run --offline --release -p laya-infer --example bench_paired_attention_gemm -- CHECKPOINT_DIRECTORY
